summary: Verified 4 new features (Home filters, Quick Repeat clone, Payment QR upload + display on public Summary, Night Mode toggle) and regressions. Backend pytest: 13/13 pass, including new tests for POST /api/upload-qr (image accepted, non-image 400, unknown 404) and GET /api/files/{path} (image bytes served with image content-type). Session create/update round-trips payment_qr_path. Frontend Playwright: filter pills present and counts (unsettled+settled==all); clone-session-{id} on Home prefills /sessions/new with heading 'Repeat session', same venue/currency/costs/players, players.paid reset, date set to today; QR upload shows qr-preview and remove-qr-button; after save, /summary/:id shows summary-qr-image with naturalWidth>0; theme-toggle in header on Home & Form toggles 'dark' class on <html>, persists across navigation, toggles back; live-per-player-share=₱160.00 and live-total-session-cost=₱960.00 for the worked example; paid toggle on detail updates collected amount; clone from detail (clone-session-button) navigates to /sessions/new prefilled (heading 'Repeat session' confirmed in screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: init_storage() uses a module-level cached storage key with a 404-retry-force pattern — good resilience against key rotation.
upload_qr writes a MongoDB record keyed by storage_path and serve_file requires the record to exist — protects against arbitrary path reads.
SessionForm useEffect dependency array excludes `clone` intentionally (eslint-disable) — safe because clone comes from route state and only applies on mount; documented via comment.
Summary page intentionally stays light (spec) even with dark mode enabled — verified.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_QRFlow2 session with uploaded QR; cleaned up along with leftover TEST_ArenaX and TEST_QRFlow via DELETE /api/sessions/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-3 features (filters, quick repeat, payment QR upload+display, night mode) verified end-to-end. Backend tests are consolidated in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (13 tests, pytest-xdist compatible).
